blocks.text: QUITO — Heavy rains in the Galapagos Islands killed at least one person and displaced thousands of families in the region, local authorities said on Saturday. The rainfall, thought to be associated with the El Nino phenomenon, began Friday afternoon. “This is the first time something like this has happened in Santa Cruz. We never imagined this would happen… It was a natural phenomenon that truly exceeded our expectations,” the island’s mayor, Fanny Uribe, told AFP.
